description: This file contains the implementation of BrowseViewModel, a ViewModel class responsible for managing workout filters, loading workout items from a repository, and exposing data to the UI component in an Android application.

classes.name: BrowseViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel subclass that manages workout data and filters for the browse screen, handling data loading asynchronously.

methods.name: setFilters
methods.description: Sets workout filters such as category, level, and duration range, then triggers the loading of filtered workout items.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads workout items from the repository based on current filter settings asynchronously.
